title: Dinh 2024 Fig. 2B
footer: Dinh et al. 2024 Lab Chip 24, 913-923, Fig. 2B (adapted; © The Royal Society of Chemistry: permission for reproduction to be obtained before publication, README), with the edges of the shipped opencif rc6 mask dinh2024_v1_depicted (cyan).  Scale: each panel's own 50 µm bar read with its anti-aliased ends (46.91 px; 1.0660 µm/px); rotation measured on the image (0.36-0.63°); translation fitted on features and, independently, by chamfer matching (they agree within 1.1 px).  Under each panel: the median and 90th percentile of the distance from the mask's edges to the image's outlines, the same with the mask shifted half a row pitch along and 5 µm across (the nulls), and the scale the image prefers along and across the flow (1 = the bar's).  Row pitch Λ = G + g_p = 19 + 26.1 = 45.1 µm; link length ℓ_g 54 µm.
